items.title: Q1 2025 results
items.text:
Kestrel Technologies (KSTL) announces results for Q1 2025.

Revenue of 431.3 million, against 388.2 million in the comparable quarter. Operating margin of 23.1 per cent, against 22.5 per cent.

Chief executive Nabil Khoury said: "We are taking a more cautious view of the coming period than we were three months ago."

The quarter benefited from timing on two large orders that will not repeat, and the order book at the period end was lower than at the same point last year.

The board reaffirms the guidance given in February and expects to finish the year within the range then indicated.

This release contains forward-looking statements which are subject to the risks set out in the annual report.
